title: Demonic Bull Warrior
description: A massive demonic bull-like creature with large curved horns, glowing red eyes, and bat-like wings stands triumphantly in the center of a battlefield. It wears ornate black armor with glowing red runes, holds a large sword, and breathes green energy from its mouth while surrounded by smaller demonic figures, broken weapons, skulls, and lava flows under a dramatic red and purple sky.
prompt: A towering demonic bull warrior with massive curved horns, glowing red eyes, and huge bat-like wings, clad in ornate black armor with glowing red runes and skull motifs, stands in the center of a chaotic battlefield. It roars while breathing bright green energy from its mouth, holding a large sword in one hand, surrounded by smaller demonic creatures, broken swords, skulls, blood, and lava under a dark stormy sky with red and purple clouds.
